plaatsen.tekst: And they that have believing masters, let them ➔ not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
